verses.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.pt: Agora cantarei a meu amado o cântico de meu querido de sua vinha: meu amado tem uma vinha, em um morro fértil;
verses.en_web: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard. My beloved had a vineyard on a very fruitful hill.
verses.en_bbe: Let me make a song about my loved one, a song of love for his vine-garden. My loved one had a vine-garden on a fertile hill:

verses.en: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.pt: E a cercou, e limpou das pedras, e a plantou de excelentes videiras, e edificou no meio dela uma torre; e também fundou nela uma prensa de uvas; e esperava que desse uvas boas, porém deu uvas imprestáveis.
verses.en_web: He dug it up, gathered out its stones, planted it with the choicest vine, built a tower in the middle of it, and also cut out a wine press therein. He looked for it to yield grapes, but it yielded wild grapes.
verses.en_bbe: And after working the earth of it with a spade, he took away its stones, and put in it a very special vine; and he put up a watchtower in the middle of it, hollowing out in the rock a place for the grape-crushing; and he was hoping that it would give the best grapes, but it gave common grapes.

verses.en: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.pt: E agora, ó moradores de Jerusalém, e vós homens de Judá? Julgai, eu vos peço, entre mim e minha vinha.
verses.en_web: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.
verses.en_bbe: And now, you people of Jerusalem and you men of Judah, be the judges between me and my vine-garden.

verses.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.pt: O que mais podia ser feito à minha vinha, que eu não tenha já feito? Se eu esperava uvas boas, como, pois, veio dar uvas imprestáveis?
verses.en_web: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? Why, when I looked for it to yield grapes, did it yield wild grapes?
verses.en_bbe: Is there anything which might have been done for my vine-garden which I have not done? why then, when I was hoping for the best grapes did it give me common grapes?

verses.en: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.pt: Por isso agora eu vos farei saber o que farei à minha vinha: tirarei sua cerca, para que sirva de pastagem; derrubarei seu muro, para que seja pisada;
verses.en_web: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled down.
verses.en_bbe: And now, this is what I will do to my vine-garden: I will take away the circle of thorns round it, and it will be burned up; its wall will be broken down and the beasts of the field will go through it;

verses.en: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.pt: E eu a tornarei uma terra abandonada; não será podada, nem cavada; mas crescerão nela cardos e espinhos; e darei ordens às nuvens, para que não chovam chuva sobre ela.
verses.en_web: I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned nor hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain on it.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will make it waste; its branches will not be touched with the knife, or the earth worked with the spade; but blackberries and thorns will come up in it: and I will give orders to the clouds not to send rain on it.

verses.en: For the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.pt: Porque a vinha do SENHOR dos exércitos é a casa de Israel, e os homens de Judá são suas plantas agradáveis; porém ele esperava juízo, e eis aqui opressão; ele esperava justiça, e eis aqui clamor.
verses.en_web: For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for justice, but, behold, oppression; for righteousness, but, behold, a cry of distress.
verses.en_bbe: For the vine-garden of the Lord of armies is the people of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plant of his delight: and he was looking for upright judging, and there was blood; for righteousness, and there was a cry for help.

verses.en: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.pt: Ai dos que juntam uma casas, e acumulam propriedades de terra, até que não tenha sobrado mais lugar, para que somente vós fiqueis como moradores no meio da terra.
verses.en_web: Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone in the middle of the land!
verses.en_bbe: Cursed are those who are joining house to house, and putting field to field, till there is no more living-space for any but themselves in all the land!

verses.en: In mine ears said the LORD of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.pt: O SENHOR dos exércitos disse aos meus ouvidos: Verdadeiramente muitas casas se tornarão desertas, até as grandes e valiosas ficarão sem moradores!
verses.en_web: In my ears, Yahweh of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate, even great and beautiful, unoccupied.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord of armies has said to me secretly, Truly, numbers of great and fair houses will be waste, with no one living in them.

verses.en: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.pt: E dez jeiras de vinha darão apenas um bato; e um ômer de semente dará apenas um efa.
verses.en_web: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield an ephah.”
verses.en_bbe: For ten fields of vines will only give one measure of wine, and a great amount of seed will only give a small measure of grain.

verses.en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.pt: Ai dos que se levantam cedo pela manhã, para buscarem bebida alcoólica, e continuam até a noite, até que o vinho os esquente.
verses.en_web: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; who stay late into the night, until wine inflames them!
verses.en_bbe: Cursed are those who get up early in the morning to give themselves up to strong drink; who keep on drinking far into the night till they are heated with wine!

verses.en: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.pt: E harpas, liras, tamborins, gaitas e vinho há em seus banquetes; porém não olham para a obra do SENHOR, nem veem a obra de suas próprias mãos.
verses.en_web: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.
verses.en_bbe: And corded instruments and wind-instruments and wine are in their feasts: but they give no thought to the work of the Lord, and they are not interested in what his hands are doing.

verses.en: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.pt: Por isso meu povo será levado cativo, porque não tem conhecimento; seus nobres terão fome, e sua multidão se secará de sede.
verses.en_web: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge. Their honorable men are famished, and their multitudes are parched with thirst.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause my people are taken away as prisoners into strange countries for need of knowledge: and their rulers are wasted for need of food, and their loud-voiced feasters are dry for need of water.

verses.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.pt: Por isso o Xeol alargou seu avidez, e sua boca se abriu tanto que não se pode medir, e ali descerão a nobreza e também a multidão, em meio a barulhos e com os que festejam.
verses.en_web: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, their multitude, their pomp, and he who rejoices among them, descend into it.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause the underworld has made wide its throat, opening its mouth without limit: and her glory, and the noise of her masses, and her loud-voiced feasters, will go down into it.

verses.en: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.pt: Então as pessoas serão rebaixadas, e os homens serão humilhados; e os olhos dos arrogantes se humilharão.
verses.en_web: So man is brought low, mankind is humbled, and the eyes of the arrogant ones are humbled;
verses.en_bbe: And the poor man's head is bent, and the great man goes down on his face, and the eyes of pride are put to shame:

verses.en: But the LORD of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.pt: Mas o SENHOR dos exércitos será exaltado com juízo; e Deus, o Santo, será santificado com justiça.
verses.en_web: but Yahweh of Armies is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord of armies is lifted up as judge, and the Holy God is seen to be holy in righteousness.

verses.en: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.pt: E os cordeiros pastarão como se fosse seus próprios pastos, e os estranhos comerão do alimento proveniente dos lugares abandonados dos ricos.
verses.en_web: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture, and strangers will eat the ruins of the rich.
verses.en_bbe: Then the lambs will get food as in their grass-lands, and the fat cattle will be feasting in the waste places.

verses.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.pt: Ai dos que puxam perversidade com cordas de futilidade, e pelo pecado como que com cordas de carruagens!
verses.en_web: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope;
verses.en_bbe: Cursed are those who make use of ox-cords for pulling the evil thing, and the bands of a young ox for their sin!

verses.en: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.pt: E dizem: Que ele se apresse, acelere sua obra, para que a vejamos; e aproxime-se e venha o conselho do Santo de Israel, para que possamos saber.
verses.en_web: Who say, “Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw near and come, that we may know it!”
verses.en_bbe: Who say, Let him do his work quickly, let him make it sudden, so that we may see it: let the design of the Holy One of Israel come near, so that it may be clear to us.

verses.en: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.pt: Ai dos que chamam o mal de bem, e o bem de mal; que trocam as trevas pela luz, e a luz pelas trevas; e trocam o amargo pelo doce, e o doce pelo amargo!
verses.en_web: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil; who put darkness for light, and light for darkness; who put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.en_bbe: Cursed are those who give the name of good to evil, and of evil to what is good: who make light dark, and dark light: who make bitter sweet, and sweet bitter!

verses.en: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.pt: Ai dos que se acham sábios aos seus próprios olhos, e prudentes para si mesmos!
verses.en_web: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.en_bbe: Cursed are those who seem wise to themselves, and who take pride in their knowledge!

verses.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.pt: Ai dos que se acham corajosos para beberem vinho, e homens fortes para misturarem bebida alcoólica!
verses.en_web: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine, and champions at mixing strong drink;
verses.en_bbe: Cursed are those who are strong to take wine, and great in making mixed drinks!

verses.en: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.pt: Ai d os que inocentam o perverso por causa de suborno, e se desviam da justiça dos justos!
verses.en_web: who acquit the guilty for a bribe, but deny justice for the innocent!
verses.en_bbe: Who for a reward give support to the cause of the sinner, and who take away the righteousness of the upright from him.

verses.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the LORD of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.pt: Por isso, como a língua de fogo consome a estopa, e a chama queima a palha, assim sua raiz será como podridão, e sua flor se desfará como o pó; pois rejeitaram a Lei do SENHOR dos exércitos, e desprezaram a palavra do Santo de Israel.
verses.en_web: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust; because they have rejected the law of Yahweh of Armies, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: For this cause, as the waste of the grain is burned up by tongues of fire, and as the dry grass goes down before the flame, so their root will be like the dry stems of grain, and their flower will go up in dust: because they have gone against the law of the Lord of armies, and have given no honour to the word of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.en: Therefore is the anger of the LORD kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.pt: Por isso se acendeu a ira do SENHOR contra seu povo, e estendeu sua mão contra ele, e o feriu; e as montanhas tremeram, e seus cadáveres foram como lixo no meio das ruas; com tudo isto ele não retrocedeu sua ira; ao contrário, sua mão ainda está estendida.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burns against his people, and he has stretched out his hand against them, and has struck them. The mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the middle of the streets. For all this, his anger is not turned away, but his hand is still stretched out.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason the wrath of the Lord has been burning against his people, and his hand has been stretched out against them in punishment, and the hills were shaking, and their dead bodies were like waste in the open places of the town.

verses.en: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.pt: E ele levantará uma bandeira para as nações distantes, e lhes assoviará desde os confins da terra; e eis que virão com rapidez apressadamente.
verses.en_web: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far, and he will whistle for them from the end of the earth. Behold, they will come speedily and swiftly.
verses.en_bbe: And he will let a flag be lifted up as a sign to a far-off nation, whistling to them from the ends of the earth: and they will come quickly and suddenly.

verses.en: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.pt: Não haverá entre eles cansado ou quem tropece; ninguém cochilará, nem dormirá; nem se desatará o cinto de seus lombos, nem será arrebentada a tira de seus calçados.
verses.en_web: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them; no one shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the belt of their waist be untied, nor the strap of their sandals be broken:
verses.en_bbe: There is no weariness among them, and no man is feeble-footed: they come without resting or sleeping, and the cord of their shoes is not broken.

verses.en: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.pt: Suas flechas estarão afiadas, e todos os seus arcos prontos para atirar; os cascos de seus cavalos serão comparáveis a rochas, e as rodas de suas carruagens como redemoinhos de vento.
verses.en_web: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Their horses’ hoofs will be like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind.
verses.en_bbe: Their arrows are sharp, and every bow is bent: the feet of their horses are like rock, and their wheels are like a rushing storm.

verses.en: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.pt: O rugido deles será como o de um leão feroz, e bramarão como filhotes de leão; e rugirão, e tomarão a presa, e a levarão, e não haverá quem a resgate.
verses.en_web: Their roaring will be like a lioness. They will roar like young lions. Yes, they shall roar, and seize their prey and carry it off, and there will be no one to deliver.
verses.en_bbe: The sound of their armies will be like the voice of a lion, and their war-cry like the noise of young lions: with loud cries they will come down on their food and will take it away safely, and there will be no one to take it out of their hands.

verses.en: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.pt: E bramarão contra ela naquele dia como o bramido do mar; então olharão para a terra, e eis que há trevas e aflição; e a luz se escurecerá em suas nuvens.
verses.en_web: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea. If one looks to the land behold, darkness and distress. The light is darkened in its clouds.
verses.en_bbe: And his voice will be loud over him in that day like the sounding of the sea: and if a man's eyes are turned to the earth, it is all dark and full of trouble; and the light is made dark by thick clouds.
